info.title: Hệ thống AI Quân khu 3 (Hỗ trợ xử lý văn bản)

get.description: Liveness probe: the process is up and the database answers.
The organisation chart as a flat, ordered list (for filters and account forms).

post.description: Exchanges username and password for an access token.

get.description: The signed-in user.

post.description: Changes the signed-in user's own password.

get.description: Documents the signed-in user may read, filtered and paged.

post.description: Uploads one or more files. Each file succeeds or fails on its own; the response says which.

get.description: Types, years and tags of the documents the user may read, with counts (for the filter panel).
One document with its processing steps.

patch.description: Corrects metadata by hand (uploader or administrator).

delete.description: Deletes the document, its file and its index entries (uploader or administrator).

get.description: The document's text, paragraph by paragraph, for the viewer.

schema.title: Response Read Content Api Documents  Document Id  Content Get

get.description: Page count and the positioned blocks of a scanned document (404 when it was not read with block positions).
Page `number` (from 1) of a scanned document as a PNG image.

The document as a PDF for the page viewer: the original PDF, or the one made from the Word file (built once, then kept).
Streamed with ``Range`` support so the viewer fetches only the pages it shows.
The original file, streamed from the object store (supports ``Range``; `inline=true` lets a viewer show it in the page).

put.description: Replaces the hand-made tags (uploader or administrator); computed tags stay.

post.description: Queues the document for processing again.

get.description: Profiles, accepted file types, size limit and retention.

post.description: Uploads a file privately and checks it.

get.description: The last result of a session.

post.description: Checks the original again with other options.
Applies the chosen edits and writes the corrected copy (download it from `/fixed`).

get.description: The file as uploaded (converted to .docx if it was .doc).
The corrected copy.
Plain-text list of every finding.
A copy of the document with the findings as Word comments.

post.description: Saves the original or corrected file into the document store (where it is indexed like any upload).

get.description: Accepted file types, size and length limits, retention.

post.description: Uploads a Word, PDF or text file privately and checks its spelling.
Checks the spelling of pasted text.

get.description: The findings of a session.

put.description: Sets the words this session must not report (the "bỏ qua tất cả" list).

post.description: Applies the chosen edits and writes the corrected copy (download it from `/fixed`).

get.description: The file as uploaded (a .doc converted to .docx).
The corrected copy.
Plain-text list of the findings.
The user's conversations, most recent first.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api Chat Sessions Get

post.description: Starts a conversation.

get.description: A conversation with its messages, attached files and draft.

delete.description: Deletes a conversation with its messages, files and draft.

post.description: Starts the assistant for this conversation in the background (call when the user focuses the message box).
Sends a message and streams what the assistant does and answers as server-sent events (see docs/CHAT_API.md).
Stops the answer in progress.
Attaches a file to the conversation; it is indexed in the background (poll until `state` is `ready`).

get.description: Processing state of an attached file.
Paragraphs of an attached file for the viewer.

schema.title: Response Attachment Content Api Chat Sessions  Session Id  Attachments  Attachment Id  Content Get

get.description: The attached file as uploaded (supports ``Range``).
The conversation's draft, or null.

schema.title: Response Read Draft Api Chat Sessions  Session Id  Draft Get

post.description: Opens an empty draft of a kind of document.

patch.description: The user's edits to the draft.

post.description: Accepts the assistant's proposed change to a block.
Rejects the assistant's proposed change to a block.

Checks the draft against Thông tư 68 as the .docx would be written, its structure, and the wording against the style of
the unit it is written for.

get.description: The draft as a .docx.

post.description: Saves the draft into the document store.

get.description: All accounts.

schema.title: Response List Users Api Admin Users Get

post.description: Creates an account.

patch.description: Edits an account (role, unit, activation, password reset).

get.description: All settings sections with field metadata and current values (secrets reported only as set / not set).

schema.title: Response Get Settings Api Admin Settings Get

put.description: Saves one section. Returns what changed and whether the documents must be indexed again.

schema.title: Response Save Settings Api Admin Settings  Section  Put

post.description: Tries a connection with the given values (not saved).

schema.title: Response Test Settings Api Admin Settings  Section  Test Post

post.description: Queues every document for indexing again (after changing the embedding model).

schema.title: Response Reindex Api Admin Reindex Post

get.description: Newest-first audit rows.

schema.title: Response Audit Logs Api Admin Audit Logs Get

get.description:
Documents by state, type, unit and month, and what each unit did with the assistant in the period. An administrator sees
the whole organisation, a commander their unit and the units under it; anyone else gets 403.

parameters.name: days

schema.description: Period of the usage figures: 7, 30 or 90 days.
schema.title: Days

parameters.description: Period of the usage figures: 7, 30 or 90 days.

BlockEdit.title: BlockEdit
BlockEdit.description: New text of a block, or the new spec of a table block (``{"columns", "rows"}``, see app.drafting.tables).

CanvasUsage.title: CanvasUsage
CanvasUsage.description: Decisions on the assistant's proposals in the period. Counts only; the text is not included.

CheckOptions.title: CheckOptions
CheckOptions.description: What the screen offers before a file is chosen.

CheckOut.title: CheckOut
CheckOut.description:
A checked file. `result` is doccheck's display payload (see docs/FORMAT_CHECK_API.md): facts, counts, `banner`
(findings without a location), `paras` (each with `msgs` and spelling `marks`), selectable `items` and `manual` notes.

CountItem.title: CountItem
CountItem.description: One bar of a chart: a stable key, the text shown and how many.

DocumentDetail.title: DocumentDetail
DocumentDetail.description: A single document with its processing history.

DocumentPage.title: DocumentPage
DocumentPage.description: One page of a listing plus the per-state totals for the filter chips.

DraftCreate.title: DraftCreate
DraftCreate.description: Open a draft by hand (the assistant normally does this).

DraftOut.title: DraftOut
DraftOut.description: The conversation's draft as the canvas shows it (see docs/CHAT_API.md).

DraftPatch.title: DraftPatch
DraftPatch.description:
The user's edits to the draft: fields by key, text of existing blocks, one insertion, deletions, the style choice, the
drafting unit (an id within the user's own unit), and passages whose "figures changed" mark the user dismisses.

Facets.title: Facets
Facets.description: Choices for the filter panel with the number of readable documents behind each.

FixRequest.title: FixRequest
FixRequest.description: Edits to apply: ids from `result.items[].id`. `track` leaves Word tracked changes, `apply` writes the new format directly.

IgnoreRequest.title: IgnoreRequest
IgnoreRequest.description: The complete ignore list: words (case-insensitive) the screen must not report in this session.

MessageIn.title: MessageIn
MessageIn.description: A message to the assistant. `context` names the canvas block (and the selected text) the request is about.

MessageOut.title: MessageOut
MessageOut.description: One message. For the assistant, `content` carries the numbered citations ``[1]`` that `citations[].n` refers to.

MetadataUpdate.title: MetadataUpdate
MetadataUpdate.description: Manual corrections of extracted metadata; omitted fields are unchanged.

Paragraph.title: Paragraph
Paragraph.description: One paragraph of the document viewer; `pi` is the source index that citations refer to.

PasswordChange.title: PasswordChange
PasswordChange.description: A user changing their own password.

SaveRequest.title: SaveRequest
SaveRequest.description: Saving a checked file into the document store.

ScanBlock.title: ScanBlock
ScanBlock.description: A block of a scanned page: kind, position (x0, y0, x1, y1 on a 0-1000 scale of the page), text, and the viewer paragraphs written from it.

SessionCreate.title: SessionCreate
SessionCreate.description: Start a conversation (title optional; it is taken from the first message otherwise).

confirm_hosts.title: Confirm Hosts
confirm_hosts.description: External hosts the administrator accepts to send document text to.

SettingsSave.title: SettingsSave
SettingsSave.description: Values for one settings section. A secret that is omitted or null is kept; an empty string clears it.

SettingsTest.title: SettingsTest
SettingsTest.description: Values to try without saving them (omitted secrets use the saved ones).

SpellFixOut.title: SpellFixOut
SpellFixOut.description: Outcome of applying edits; `after.spelling` is what a new check of the corrected copy still finds.

SpellFixRequest.title: SpellFixRequest
SpellFixRequest.description: Edits to apply: ids from `result.items[].id`. `track` leaves Word tracked changes, `apply` writes the text directly.

SpellOptions.title: SpellOptions
SpellOptions.description: What the screen offers before anything is checked.

SpellOut.title: SpellOut
SpellOut.description:
A checked file or text. `result` has the shape of a format-check payload with spelling only (see docs/SPELLCHECK_API.md):
`paras` with `marks`, selectable `items` (kind ``spelling``), hand-fix `manual` notes, `counts`, and `ignored` (findings hidden
by the ignore list).

StyleChoice.title: StyleChoice
StyleChoice.description: The preset and detail level picked on the canvas (unknown values fall back to the defaults).

TagsUpdate.title: TagsUpdate
TagsUpdate.description: The hand-made tags of a document (the whole list; computed tags are not affected).

TextRequest.title: TextRequest
TextRequest.description: Pasted text to check (lines separated by line breaks).

UnitCount.title: UnitCount
UnitCount.description: Documents directly in one unit, with the top-level branch (Bộ Tham mưu, Cục Chính trị...) it belongs to.

UnitUsage.title: UnitUsage
UnitUsage.description: What the people of one unit did in the chosen period.

UploadItem.title: UploadItem
UploadItem.description: Outcome for one file of a (possibly multi-file) upload; a failing file does not stop the others.

UploadResult.title: UploadResult
UploadResult.description: Per-file outcomes of an upload request.

UserOut.title: UserOut
UserOut.description: An account as shown to clients (never includes the password hash).

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description: Administrator editing an account; omitted fields are left unchanged.
